SCENE sc_001 0-42500 EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY
EP22:E1 0-4000 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.
EP22:E2 0-4000 ACTION: Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.
EP22:E3 4000-7000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.
EP22:E4 6500-8500 ACTION: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.
EP22:E5 7000-11100 PRUDENCE [Urgent, Whispering]: "Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."
EP22:E6 11100-14200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.
EP22:E7 11200-14200 LADY JULIANA [Resolute, Quiet]: "No one will recognize me dressed like this."
EP22:E8 14200-19000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.
EP22:E9 14200-19000 PRUDENCE [Nervous, Warning]: "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."
EP22:E10 19000-21200 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.
EP22:E11 19100-21000 LADY JULIANA [Determined]: "The Duchess is dying."
EP22:E12 21200-25800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.
EP22:E13 22000-25500 LADY JULIANA [Defiant, Firm]: "I saved Toby. I can save her."
EP22:E14 25800-28100 CAMERA: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.
EP22:E15 26000-28100 PRUDENCE [Fretful]: "And if they discover who you are?"
EP22:E16 28100-31500 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.
EP22:E17 28200-31000 LADY JULIANA [Steely, Selfless]: "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."
EP22:E18 31500-36200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.
EP22:E19 33800-36000 PRUDENCE [Solemn]: "Then forget you were ever a lady."
EP22:E20 36200-39800 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.
EP22:E21 37000-39500 LADY JULIANA [Quietly Resolute]: "Today, I am only a maid."
EP22:E22 39800-42500 ACTION: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
SCENE sc_002 42500-88500 INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
EP22:E23 43000-44200 HOUSEKEEPER [Sharp, Stern, O.S.]: "Prudence."
EP22:E24 43000-46000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.
EP22:E25 44300-45600 HOUSEKEEPER [Suspicious]: "Who is this?"
EP22:E26 46000-49200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.
EP22:E27 46000-49000 PRUDENCE [Submissive]: "Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."
EP22:E28 49200-52200 CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.
EP22:E29 49500-51800 HOUSEKEEPER [Cold, Skeptical]: "She looks soft."
EP22:E30 51800-53000 ACTION: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
EP22:E31 52800-55200 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.
EP22:E32 52800-54800 LADY JULIANA [Humble, Steady]: "I can work, ma'am."
EP22:E33 55200-58500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.
EP22:E34 56000-58000 HOUSEKEEPER [Demanding]: "Can you scrub stone?"
EP22:E35 58500-60000 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.
EP22:E36 58500-59800 LADY JULIANA [Subdued]: "Yes, ma'am."
EP22:E37 60200-61800 HOUSEKEEPER [Harsh, O.S.]: "Carry coal?"
EP22:E38 60200-62300 CAMERA: Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.
EP22:E39 62300-64200 CAMERA: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.
EP22:E40 62500-63800 LADY JULIANA [Polite]: "Yes, ma'am."
EP22:E41 64200-69800 CAMERA: Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.
EP22:E42 66000-69500 HOUSEKEEPER [Menacing, Threatening]: "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"
EP22:E43 69800-73000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.
EP22:E44 71200-72600 LADY JULIANA [Subdued, Steady]: "Yes, ma'am."
EP22:E45 73000-78000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.
EP22:E46 73200-77500 HOUSEKEEPER [Stern, Dismissive]: "Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls."
EP22:E47 77500-81000 ACTION: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
EP22:E48 78500-81800 CAMERA: Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.
EP22:E49 79000-81000 PRUDENCE [Relieved, Whispering]: "That was close."
EP22:E50 81800-84600 CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.
EP22:E51 82500-84500 LADY JULIANA [Urgent, Quiet]: "Where is the West Wing?"
EP22:E52 84600-88500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.
EP22:E53 84800-88000 PRUDENCE [Nervous, Warning]: "Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there."
SCENE sc_003 88500-102000 INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS
EP22:E54 88500-92000 CAMERA: Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
EP22:E55 91500-96000 ACTION: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
EP22:E56 92000-96000 CAMERA: Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.
EP22:E57 94500-96000 LADY JULIANA [Breathless]: "This house..."
EP22:E58 96000-98500 ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
EP22:E59 96000-98800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.
EP22:E60 96000-98500 PRUDENCE [Panicked, Hushed]: "Do not stare. Keep walking."
EP22:E61 98800-102000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
SCENE sc_004 102000-131000 INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS
EP22:E62 102000-105500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
EP22:E63 105500-108500 ACTION: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
EP22:E64 105500-108500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
EP22:E65 106500-108500 SOUND: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
EP22:E66 108500-113800 CAMERA: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
EP22:E67 109000-114000 SOUND: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
EP22:E68 113800-116000 ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
EP22:E69 114000-115500 LADY JULIANA [Gentle, Concerned]: "Your Grace?"
EP22:E70 115500-118200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
EP22:E71 118200-120800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.
EP22:E72 118200-119800 LADY JULIANA [Soft, Comforting]: "Do not speak."
EP22:E73 120800-125500 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
EP22:E74 123000-125800 ACTION: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
EP22:E75 123500-125800 LADY JULIANA [Shocked, Murmuring]: "This isn't ordinary fever."
EP22:E76 125800-127000 ACTION: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
EP22:E77 125800-127000 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
EP22:E78 127000-128800 CAMERA: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.
EP22:E79 127200-128800 LADY JULIANA [Urgent, Alarmed]: "Who has been treating you?"
EP22:E80 128800-131000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.
